Eligibility of Tenderer : C. Qualification Criteria
1. The minimum number of years of general experience of the Tenderer in the construction works as Prime Contractor or
Subcontractor or Management Contractor shall be 10 (TEN) years.
2. The minimum specific experience as a Prime Contractor or Subcontractor or Management Contractor in construction works of at
least 1 (One) contract of road and drain construction or similar nature of works successfully completed within the last 5(Five)
years, each with a value of at least BDT 5,10,00,000.00 (Five Crore & ten lac) in any government, semi-government or
autonomous body.
3. The required average annual construction turnover shall be greater than Tk BDT 10.00 (Ten) Crore over the best 3(Three) years
in the last 5(Five) years.
4. The minimum amount of liquid assets i.e working capital or credit line(s) of the Tenderers shall be Tk BDT 5.00 (Five) Crore
